# nomatron_group (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron group by organization name and exact group name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_group" "example" {
  org_name = "platform"
  name     = "admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact group name.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was created.
- `description` (String) Group description.
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the group.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID that owns the group.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Owner user ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was last updated.
